reason: The README clearly describes a QQ official bot integration that exposes the full agent through private, group, and channel messages, including tool, memory, subagent, and filesystem capabilities; the combination of external messaging, credentials, and privileged agent execution warrants human review.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的完整智能体能力接入 QQ 官方机器人，支持私聊、群聊和频道消息交互。
summaries.en: Connects the DeepSeek Harness full agent to the QQ official bot platform for private, group, and channel conversations.

capabilities: Connects to QQ official bot APIs over WebSocket
Receives and sends QQ private, group, and channel messages
Routes QQ conversations to an agent with tools, memory, subagents, and filesystem access
Handles QQ credentials and supports allowlists, rate limits, and inline approval controls
